children.text: Successfully developed and delivered the "GTCO Food Festival Vendor Guide (the largest food festival in Africa)," a full-stack web application that enhanced the attendee experience for a large food festival. The project was highly praised by management and attracted over 260 visitors and 2,100 page views during the event.
Full-Stack Development: Engineered the complete solution, including an interactive venue map and a personalized vendor recommendation engine.
Backend & API: Built a RESTful API using Python and FastAPI to handle all data processing, filtering, and recommendation logic.
Data Pipeline: Implemented an automated data pipeline with Pandas and SQLAlchemy to efficiently parse vendor data from spreadsheets and populate a SQLite database.

Intelligent Recommendation Engine: Architected the core recommendation feature using Scikit-learn to perform TF-IDF vectorization and calculate cosine similarity, delivering highly relevant vendor suggestions based on user queries and dietary filters.

AI-Powered Summaries: Integrated the Gemini API to generate concise, personalized summaries for each recommendation, clearly explaining the match to the user and significantly improving their experience.
Recognition & Impact: Received direct commendation from event management on the successful completion and performance of the app, leading to an invitation for follow-on projects.
